# Outreach

> Outreach is a web studio in Tbilisi, Georgia. It designs, builds, hosts and maintains fast, mobile-ready websites for small businesses. Clients see a working demo before paying, then rent the site monthly or buy it outright. The site is available in English, Georgian (https://outreach.pre-production.workers.dev/ka/) and Russian (https://outreach.pre-production.workers.dev/ru/).

## Pages

- [Home](https://outreach.pre-production.workers.dev/): Outreach designs, builds and hosts fast websites for small businesses in Georgia. See a working demo first, then rent from 100 ₾/month or buy it.
- [Services](https://outreach.pre-production.workers.dev/services/): Design and build, hosting and care, rent or own: everything Outreach does for small businesses in Georgia, in plain words.
- [How it works](https://outreach.pre-production.workers.dev/how-it-works/): We build your website first and send you a link. You look at it on your phone, then decide to rent or buy. No lock-in.
- [Pricing](https://outreach.pre-production.workers.dev/pricing/): START 100 ₾, CHAT 160 ₾, PRO 250 ₾, PAY 350 ₾ a month with hosting, SSL and changes included. Buy outright from 2,000 ₾.
- [Contact](https://outreach.pre-production.workers.dev/contact/): Talk to Outreach about a website for your business. Based in Tbilisi, working with small businesses across Georgia.

## Plans

- START: 100 ₾/month (setup 150 ₾). A site for your business. Includes: Your own .ge domain, Hosting and SSL, One change a month.
- CHAT: 160 ₾/month (setup 150 ₾). A site that answers questions. Includes: Everything in START, FAQ chat for your customers, Two changes a month.
- PRO: 250 ₾/month (setup 250 ₾). A site that collects enquiries. Includes: Everything in CHAT, Booking and contact forms, Google Business profile.
- PAY: 350 ₾/month (setup 450 ₾). A site that takes payment. Includes: Everything in PRO, Online payments, Money goes straight to your bank.

Monthly billing, cancel with 30 days notice, setup charged once. Hosting, SSL and changes included.

## FAQ

- What happens if I stop paying? The domain is registered in your name from day one, so it stays yours. We hand over DNS control within five working days, and export your form data as a spreadsheet.
- Can I buy the site instead of renting? Yes. Buying outright runs 2,000–4,200 ₾ depending on the package. After twelve paid months the buyout price drops, reaching 60% at two years.
- Do I need to understand any of this? No. You know your business, we handle the website. We ask for your text and photos and do the rest.
- How fast does it go live? Setup takes five working days once we have your content. Changes after that are two to three working days depending on your package.
